definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over an extended period. Commonly used in product reviews, manufacturing, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: この{素材|そざい}は{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}が{高|たか}い。
{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}に{優|すぐ}れた{製品|せいひん}を{選|えら}びたい。
examples.english: I want to choose a product with excellent durability.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}を{考慮|こうりょ}して{設計|せっけい}されている。
examples.english: This building was designed with durability in mind.

notes:
The quality of being able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over time. Formed from {耐久|たいきゅう} (endurance) + {性|せい} (quality/property). Commonly used in product reviews, manufacturing, and construction contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}が{高|たか}い: high durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}がある: to be durable
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}を{高|たか}める: to increase durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}テスト: durability test

RELATED WORDS:
- {耐久|たいきゅう}: endurance — the base noun without the property suffix
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}: sturdy, strong — describes the quality of being tough in everyday language
- {頑丈|がんじょう}: robust, solidly built — emphasizes physical sturdiness
